review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: Narrow security/demo hotfix requested by the owner: convert current public access to demo posture, block public live supporter-handoff data routes, add a demo access explanation, and visibly label the public experience as Demo. This does not authorize the broader v3.18 visual/commercial release candidate.

ai_uses.purpose: Preserve the existing Z-Girl reflection/support architecture while restricting unauthorized public live-data use
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: Public visitors can safely explore Z-Girl while live supporter handoffs and participant follow-up records remain unavailable until an approved access path exists
ai_uses.human_oversight: Existing institutional and credential operator authorization remains unchanged; participant sharing remains human-controlled; broader commercial launch remains owner-governed
ai_uses.provenance: Z-Girl governed application repository lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach; central 4L Premium + AI Impact gate

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: The hotfix automates only the public demo/live-data boundary. Existing secure operator systems remain authoritative and broader customer entitlements require a separate server-validated access design.

evidence: Unauthorized live-data paths route to a purpose-built Z-Girl Demo access experience instead of a broken or generic denial page
Public header clearly identifies the experience as Demo
Existing adaptive reflection value remains explorable while live supporter persistence is withheld from anonymous public users
Reduces unauthorized live-data use while preserving safe public discovery and pilot conversion paths
Middleware blocks support/share, receive, follow-up, admin/review, and trusted-support API paths in public demo mode
No client-controlled authorization bypass is present
Demo boundary is text-first, responsive, keyboard-navigable, and uses existing accessible application components
No character canon, lesson content, or brand asset is changed beyond a Demo status label
Live supporter-handoff creation and participant return routes are disabled for anonymous public use
Existing credential/institution operator authentication remains untouched
Broader release authority is not granted

exceptions: Owner approval applies only to this narrow public demo/access-security hotfix requested in the current production session. It does not approve PR #48, unresolved human-visual rights, paid commercial launch, affiliate/reseller terms, fundraising claims, institutional activation, or new customer entitlement architecture.
